what_happened: Task description and ruling both carry successor 3 (delete review-stack-prepare.sh) as ordered after nothing with no caller; live tree shows milestone-review-handoff.sh now calls it (692 closed as written) and two context docs cite it as the live ref-plumbing implementation (690), so successor 3 must be ordered after successors 4 and 1.

The task description directs an autonomous dispatch to create six task records via /task and write edges onto them. multi-task-creation-standard.md's 'Requesting a Proposal Packet, Not Filing, From an Autonomous Dispatch' section names exactly this as a forbidden shape: confirmed creation is foreground-only and AskUserQuestion is withheld from dispatched subagents; state-write.sh's audit-evidence gate would need a human-authored override. The research report flagged the interactive steps as an unresolved risk without reading the standard. The plan re-shapes implementation to the required shape: a creation-ready proposal packet, one follow_up_task issue entry per candidate, and a foreground runbook; only the two description revisions (sanctioned mechanical route) are performed by the dispatch.

The research report states neither 694 nor 655 has a plans/ directory. 655 has an empty plans/ directory (plus empty reports/ and summaries/); 694 has no task directory at all. The conclusion (Description Update path for both, since no plan file exists) stands; the plan states the checkable condition as 'no plan file' rather than 'no plans directory'.

suite_selection_select maps the data files specs/state.json and a task's issues.jsonl to the suites that exercise their writers (over 80 suites for specs/state.json). A plan phase that only edits two description fields through state-write.sh therefore cannot make a Tier Justification the advisory validator accepts unless it names no suite at all: a sub-case (a) sentinel claim is flagged false, and naming example suites is flagged as under-verifying. plan-format.md's sub-case (a) text says a specs-only set is covered by validate-artifact or a diff read-through, which the selector's output contradicts for these two paths.

Packet carries sixteen edges where the plan and report carry fifteen. narrow_handoff_to_print_slice and slice_bar_measurement_and_declaration were unordered but both reconcile agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json line counts (each edits a context document registered there, verified by grep), so the batching rule's unordered-overlap edge was added: the handoff record after the bar record. Territory-only and operator-reversible; recorded in the packet's edge_count.delta_from_plan. Also: the ruling names skills/skill-git-workflow/SKILL.md as a /merge mention but the ruling's own search finds none there, so it was left out of remove_merge_command's file_scope and flagged for that record's research.

Every carried figure in the plan's premise table re-measured unchanged at implementation time (state baseline, statuses of 655/690-697, three greps, file sizes); no description needed a corrected figure. The description's own claim that successor 3 is independent stays false, as the report found.

slice_command_build: build the /slice command (one script with check/build/status, the series file, commands/slice.md with both prompts and the open step, suite, registration rows); acceptance is one real slice pushed by a typed grant and opened by the operator typing /slice; depends on nothing

bind_push_grant_to_pushed_ref: bind a push grant for a non-checked-out ref to that ref's commit instead of HEAD, in hooks/please-grant.sh, hooks/guard-git-push.sh and scripts/lib/push-grant-lib.sh; depends on nothing

slice_bar_measurement_and_declaration: add the declared slice_bar key and the nearest-rank 75th-percentile measurement to the /slice bar, with its section in repo-level-declarations.md; depends on slice_command_build

narrow_handoff_to_print_slice: narrow milestone-review-handoff.sh to print the one line /slice, dropping the review-stack-prepare.sh call, the /please push lines and the review.ref write; reverses the closed handoff_prints_review_stack deliverable; depends on slice_command_build, slice_bar_measurement_and_declaration

delete_review_stack_inference_route: delete review-stack-prepare.sh, its suite, the review_base section and Overview sentences, the review-manifest row, and re-point two context documents; depends on narrow_handoff_to_print_slice, slice_bar_measurement_and_declaration

remove_merge_command: delete commands/merge.md, remove the merge minting branch of hooks/please-grant.sh and rewrite every remaining /merge reference to /slice; dispatch precondition is a pull request already opened by /slice; depends on slice_command_build, delete_review_stack_inference_route, narrow_handoff_to_print_slice, bind_push_grant_to_pushed_ref

edges onto existing records, owed with the six creations: branch_aware_orchestration_and_squash_landing gains a dependency on slice_bar_measurement_and_declaration; stack_pr_redeploy_and_second_repo_demo loses its edges onto handoff_prints_review_stack and the abandoned merge_command_stack_mode and gains one onto each of the six new records, removal and addition in one step; see records/01_creation-runbook.md

audit-task-proposals.sh returned 200 to 300 non-scope-blind verdicts per proposal (608 KB for six proposals) and no genuinely-new line, where the plan expected two flagged proposals. Every description opens with the standard source-store paragraph, which the semantic pass scores against most of the corpus (top scores 0.55 to 0.68 against unrelated closed records such as consent_gated_git_push). The verdict file still satisfies the creation gate, but the confirmation table it would render is unreadable; dispositions were written by hand into each proposal's audit_note from the mechanical overlaps and the named related records. Candidate improvement: discount a shared boilerplate preamble in the semantic pass.

Plan Phase 4 step (d) prescribed update-task-status.sh preflight <n> edge_only <session> --file-scope-add=<array> to declare territory on each new record. That flag is refused outside operation=postflight with target research, plan or implement (script header, the --file-scope-add section), and edge_only is refused without --depends-on-add. The runbook instead writes file_scope inside the creation write itself, which matches the field's creation-time definition; all six creation commands were validated with state-write.sh --dry-run (exit 0, audit-evidence gate satisfied by the pre-computed verdict file).

verify-touched.sh was issued as a foreground call with an inner timeout 540 and the Bash tool timeout raised to 600000, and the harness still moved it to the background after 180 seconds. Resolved inside the dispatch by a bounded foreground wait on the log's own rc= line (timeout 560); the run finished green before the wait began to matter. The 120000 ms default is not the only auto-background threshold observed.

state-write.sh --dry-run and update-task-status.sh --dry-run let the runbook's creation, edge-removal and edge-add command forms be proven against the live state file without writing anything, which caught the invalid --file-scope-add step before it reached the operator.

verify-touched.sh, run with no arguments exactly as the dispatch file's Batch Gate Deferral section prescribes, reported 17 owed paths and could not record them: unmapped-fallback-lib.sh line 128 tried to append to /dev/null/no-task-dir/records/full-sweep-owed.jsonl and failed with 'Not a directory', once per owed path. The run still exited 0 with 98 suites passed, so the owed paths are counted in the closing line but named nowhere durable. The no-argument form has no task directory to write the owed record into.
